definitions.explanation: A fish of the tuna family, important in Japanese cuisine both fresh (as sashimi/tataki) and dried (as katsuobushi, the base for dashi).

examples.japanese: {鰹|かつお}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦たたき→たたき：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{鰹節|かつおぶし}→鰹節：04935_katsuobushi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: To make dashi stock from dried bonito flakes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はつ}ガツオ→初ガツオ：noentry⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味覚|みかく}→味覚：04424_mikaku⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

examples.notes: {初|はつ}ガツオ refers to bonito caught in spring migration

examples.english: Bonito is an indispensable fish in Japanese food culture, used for both sashimi and dashi stock.

notes:
CULINARY USES:
{鰹|かつお} is central to Japanese cuisine in multiple forms:
- ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧ (sashimi - raw)
- ⟦たたき→たたき：noentry⟧ (tataki - seared)
- ⟦{鰹節|かつおぶし}→鰹節：04935_katsuobushi⟧ (dried bonito flakes - essential for dashi)

SEASONAL VARIETIES:
- ⟦{初|はつ}ガツオ→初ガツオ：noentry⟧ (spring catch - lean, refreshing)
- ⟦{戻|もど}りガツオ→戻りガツオ：noentry⟧ (autumn catch - fatty, rich)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {鰹|かつお}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧ (bonito sashimi)
- {鰹|かつお}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦たたき→たたき：noentry⟧ (seared bonito)
- ⟦{鰹節|かつおぶし}→鰹節：04935_katsuobushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削|けず}る→削る：03922_kezuru⟧ (shave dried bonito)

REGIONAL NOTE:
Kochi Prefecture (⟦{高知県|こうちけん}→高知県：noentry⟧) is famous for {鰹|かつお}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦たたき→たたき：noentry⟧.
